opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to a paid OneCoin program, directs viewers to a signup link, and presents referral-based earnings through a binary structure. It explains that participants can build two teams and that “you can earn ten percent whatever the volume is on your with lesser leg or your lesser team.” The structure extends beyond direct recruitment: qualifying purchases may come from people “a hundred levels down from you,” showing commissions linked to a tiered organization. It also presents a 5,030 euro purchase as producing a 24,000 euro account value, stating that “you only purchased the tycoon package for 5030 euros yet the value of your account is at 24,000 euros.” The claims promote partnership and high earnings, although some figures are accompanied by prediction and income disclaimers.
